statement: For any Grassmannian Gr(k,n), let λ¹,…,λˢ fit its k×(n−k) rectangle and satisfy Σ|λᶦ|=k(n−k). At distinct real osculation parameters, the associated Schubert varieties intersect transversely in exactly their complex Schubert intersection number of distinct real points. In the paper’s polynomial-subspace notation this count is dim((⊗_s L_(λ^(s)))_λ^sing), including the specified condition at infinity.

scope: Zero-dimensional intersections with prescribed partitions and flags osculating a rational normal curve at distinct real parameters.
